name: biomcp
description: Portable read-only biomedical search and retrieval for desktop MCP clients.
long_description: BioMCP bundles verified macOS and Windows executables as a local read-only MCP server. The separate PyPI distribution remains biomcp-cli; the unrelated biomcp PyPI package is not this project.

tools.name: biomcp
tools.description: Run one read-only BioMCP command. Prefer typed tools. Use `biomcp list <entity>` for discovery or `biomcp skill list` for workflows. Set `json` for structured output. Binary downloads and mutations are rejected.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search a biomedical entity with typed, bounded inputs.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Get one biomedical record with typed inputs. Binary assets are CLI-only.

tools.name: variant_normalize_car
tools.description: Normalize 1-50 RefSeq HGVS values with ClinGen Allele Registry.

tools.name: variant_erepo
tools.description: Get ClinGen ERepo expert assertions by CAid or gene.

tools.name: gene_cspec
tools.description: Get ClinGen CSpec manifests, pages, or attachment metadata.

tools.name: variant_articles
tools.description: Get compact literature shortlists for 1-10 variant identities.

oncokb_token.title: OncoKB Token
oncokb_token.description: Optional. Enables OncoKB therapy and level evidence for variant oncokb <id>.

disgenet_api_key.title: DisGeNET API Key
disgenet_api_key.description: Optional. Enables DisGeNET scored association sections for genes and diseases.

s2_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API Key
s2_api_key.description: Optional. Improves reliability for article TLDR, citation, reference, and recommendation calls.
